context_for_next_testing_agent: Moltbot-inspired features fully implemented. Backend endpoints: /api/sentiment/composite (returns signal, composite_score, fear_greed, news, recommendation), /api/arbitrage/scan (scans 5 exchanges for 10 symbols), /api/arbitrage/scan/{symbol} (single symbol scan), /api/strategy-health/status (3 strategies: day_trader AGGRESSIVE, long_term SMART, free_will SELECTIVE), /api/strategy-health/record (POST with strategy_id, pnl_pct, symbol), /api/strategy-health/unbench/{id}. Frontend Intel page shows Market Sentiment (BEARISH/BULLISH/NEUTRAL with composite score), Fear & Greed Index with bar chart history, Arbitrage Scanner with Scan Exchanges button, Strategy Health with 3 cards showing auto-bench after 3 losses. All 11 navigation items work: Dashboard, Trading, History, Alerts, Backtest, Intel, Analytics, SMC, Journal, Commands, Settings. Mobile responsive with hamburger menu grid.

components: Market Sentiment section - BEARISH/BULLISH/NEUTRAL signal with composite score
News sentiment - Shows sentiment, bull/bear percentages
Fear & Greed - Value (0-100), label (Extreme Fear/Fear/Neutral/Greed/Extreme Greed), bar chart history
Recommendation - AI-generated market advice based on sentiment
Arbitrage Scanner - 'Scan Exchanges' button, stats cards (Opportunities, Exchanges, Scanned, Min Spread)
Strategy Health - 3 cards (Day Trader AGGRESSIVE, Long Term SMART, Elite Alerts SELECTIVE) with score, trades, win rate, PnL, streak

sentiment_apis./api/sentiment/composite: GET - Returns signal, composite_score, news (sentiment, bullish_pct, bearish_pct, headlines), fear_greed (value, label, history), recommendation
sentiment_apis./api/sentiment/news: GET - Returns overall, score, bullish_pct, bearish_pct, headlines

arbitrage_apis./api/arbitrage/scan: GET - Full scan of 10 symbols across 5 exchanges (MEXC, Binance, Bybit, OKX, KuCoin)
arbitrage_apis./api/arbitrage/scan/{symbol}: GET - Single symbol scan, returns opportunities, prices, exchanges_checked

strategy_health_apis./api/strategy-health/status: GET - Returns 3 strategies with name, style, active, benched, score, trades, wins, losses, win_rate, total_pnl, consecutive_wins/losses, last_result
strategy_health_apis./api/strategy-health/record: POST - Record trade result, triggers AUTO-BENCH after 3 consecutive losses

navigation.desktop: 11 nav items all clickable and working
navigation.mobile: Hamburger menu opens, 3x4 grid navigation works
